meta.notes:
## Douyin recipe notes

Checked 2026-11-13 in headless Chromium with an iPhone UA (390x844), logged out. **This time `www.douyin.com/` redirected to `/jingxuan`, a desktop-style Featured grid squeezed into the phone viewport**, not the vertical slide feed seen on 2026-11-07. Douyin therefore serves at least two layouts to the same UA; rules for both are kept.

## LIVE (counted with querySelectorAll on /jingxuan)

- `.discover-video-card-img` 30, `.discover-video-card-item .videoImage` 30, `.discover-video-card-item .videoImage + div` 30 (caption, author, date)
- `.discover-tab-bar` 1 (tab row; the grid is a sibling `.semi-tabs-content`, so the row alone is hidden, not `.discover-tab-container`)
- `.tab-get_app` 1 (red Get APP tile in the left navigation)
- `[data-e2e="notice-entry"]` 1 and `[data-e2e="im-entry"]` 1

## SOURCE / earlier LIVE (slide feed, not reachable in this session)

- `[data-e2e="video-player-digg"]`, `feed-comment-icon`, `video-player-share`, `xg-video-container video`, `.xgplayer-controls xg-left-grid/xg-right-grid`, `.xgplayer-video-info-wrap`: structure copied from the 2026-11-07 capture in `feed-logged-out.html`; 0 matches on /jingxuan. The dim/faint idea (opacity 0.1 on controls, 0.3 on the info wrap) follows the "pure mode" of the greasyfork script douyin-helper (453957).
- Option ids and rules from the first version are unchanged.

## Not verified

- Logged-in pages, WKWebView, populated login panels, search/user/live pages, the AI chapter card on this layout.
- Card classes are hashed (`OeaWUf2h` etc.) and are NOT used; only `discover-*`, `videoImage`, `waterfall-*`, `tab-get_app` and `data-e2e` hooks.
- The grid fixture `jingxuan-grid.html` is hand-reduced from the live DOM (hashed classes dropped, text replaced by placeholders).
